specs.title: E2E-WF-01 lost item to collected: match, claim, verify, approve and collect

steps.title: staff ask the matching agent whether the item fits the lost report
the owner sees the item as "might be yours" and claims it
staff compare the answer with the hidden detail and approve
the owner receives a six-digit collection code that staff never see
the desk finds the item by code, checks ID and hands it over
the owner sees it collected and gets a receipt notification
the code works once: a second hand-over is refused

specs.title: E2E-DESK-05 staff verify an owner in person and hand the item over in one step
